title: German Exclusive Economic Zone from Marine Regions World EEZ v12
description: The German Exclusive Economic Zone (MRGID 5669, "German Exclusive Economic Zone", ISO_SOV1 DEU, 56,831 km2) as one feature cut from Marine Regions World EEZ v12, in EPSG:4326 with all 31 v12 attributes. The feature has two parts: a 56,555 km2 polygon that covers the North Sea and the Baltic Sea parts of the German EEZ in one piece, and a 275 km2 part in the Szczecin Lagoon. The RESKit example for northern Germany and the German North Sea selects it with ISO_SOV1 == "DEU", subtracts land, and keeps the parts west of 10 E as its offshore simulation area.

sources.title: Flanders Marine Institute (2023). Maritime Boundaries Geodatabase: Maritime Boundaries and Exclusive Economic Zones (200NM), version 12, catalogued in full as marine-regions-world-eez-v12

ethos:derivation: On 2026-09-28 the script provenance/make_german_eez_excerpt.py (kept with this entry in the source catalogue) read eez_v12.shp from marine-regions-world-eez-v12, kept the single feature with ISO_SOV1 == "DEU" (MRGID 5669), and wrote it as eez_v12_DEU.shp with geopandas/pyogrio, UTF-8. Nothing else changed: the CRS is the same (the .prj is byte-identical to eez_v12.prj), the geometry is the same (all 13,684 vertices in 2 parts, compared exactly after writing), and every attribute value is the same (compared field by field after writing). The only modification is the feature selection. The input files are byte-identical to the members of World_EEZ_v12_20231025.zip as downloaded from marineregions.org on 2026-09-29 (see marine-regions-world-eez-v12).
